ShapeStylesGallery.colored_outline_accent_1: Apply the Colored Outline Accent 1 style to the shape.
ShapeStylesGallery.moderate_effect_accent_1: Apply the Moderate Effect Accent 1 style to the shape.
ShapeStylesGallery.intense_effect_accent_1: Apply the Intense Effect Accent 1 style to the shape.

SmartArtChangeColorsGallery.colorful_range_2_3: Change the SmartArt colors to Colorful Range (Accent 2-3).
SmartArtChangeColorsGallery.dark_2_fill: Change the SmartArt colors to Dark 2 Fill.
SmartArtChangeColorsGallery.gradient_loop_accent3: Change the SmartArt colors to Gradient Loop (Accent 3).

SmartArtLayoutGallery.continuous_picture_list: Apply the Continuous Picture List layout to the SmartArt.
SmartArtLayoutGallery.radial_cycle: Apply the Radial Cycle layout to the SmartArt.
SmartArtLayoutGallery.vertical_circle_list: Apply the Vertical Circle List layout to the SmartArt.

SmartArtStylesGallery.intense_effect: Apply the Intense Effect style to the SmartArt.
SmartArtStylesGallery.metallic_scene: Apply the Metallic Scene style to the SmartArt.
SmartArtStylesGallery.moderate_effect: Apply the Moderate Effect style to the SmartArt.
SmartArtStylesGallery.sunset_scene: Apply the Sunset Scene style to the SmartArt.

TableDrawBorderPenStyle.apply_dash_small_gap: Set the outer border style of the 3×3 table to dashed (small gap). Only change the outside border, not the inner cell borders.
TableDrawBorderPenStyle.apply_dot: Set the outer border style of the 3×3 table to dotted. Only change the outside border, not the inner cell borders.
TableDrawBorderPenStyle.apply_double: Set the outer border style of the 3×3 table to double line. Only change the outside border, not the inner cell borders.
TableDrawBorderPenStyle.apply_single: Set the outer border style of the 3×3 table to single solid line. Only change the outside border, not the inner cell borders.

TableDrawBorderPenWeight.apply_0_5pt: Set the outer border weight of the 3×3 table to 0.5 pt. Only change the outside border, not the inner cell borders.
TableDrawBorderPenWeight.apply_1_0pt: Set the outer border weight of the 3×3 table to 1.0 pt. Only change the outside border, not the inner cell borders.
TableDrawBorderPenWeight.apply_2_25pt: Set the outer border weight of the 3×3 table to 2.25 pt. Only change the outside border, not the inner cell borders.
TableDrawBorderPenWeight.apply_3_0pt: Set the outer border weight of the 3×3 table to 3.0 pt. Only change the outside border, not the inner cell borders.

TableStylesGalleryWord.Grid_Table_4___Accent_1: Apply the 'Grid Table 4 - Accent 1' style to the 3x3 table (blue accent with alternating row shading).
TableStylesGalleryWord.Grid_Table_5_Dark___Accent_1: Apply the 'Grid Table 5 Dark - Accent 1' style to the 3x3 table (dark blue header and first column with white text).
TableStylesGalleryWord.Grid_Table_6_Colorful___Accent_2: Apply the 'Grid Table 6 Colorful - Accent 2' style to the 3x3 table (orange/red colorful banding with colored borders).
TableStylesGalleryWord.Plain_Table_1: Apply the 'Plain Table 1' style to the 3x3 table (light gray alternating row bands with gray borders).
TableStylesGalleryWord.Table_Grid: Apply the 'Table Grid' style to the 3x3 table (basic grid with black borders).

TextAlignGallery.bottom: Align the text to the bottom inside the text box.
TextAlignGallery.middle: Align the text to the middle inside the text box.
TextAlignGallery.top: Align the text to the top inside the text box.

TextDirectionGallery.horizontal: Set the text direction inside the text box to horizontal. The text box currently has vertical text direction applied. Keep the text box in the same position and size.
TextDirectionGallery.rotate_90_downward: Rotate the text direction inside the text box 90 degrees clockwise. Do not rotate, move, or resize the text box itself.
TextDirectionGallery.rotate_90_upward: Rotate the text direction inside the text box 90 degrees counterclockwise. Do not rotate, move, or resize the text box itself.
TextDirectionGallery.vertical_far_east: Set the text direction inside the text box to East Asian vertical writing mode. Do not rotate, move, or resize the text box itself.

TextEffectTransformGallery.fade_right: Apply the Fade Right text transform to 'Target' in the SmartArt.
TextEffectTransformGallery.inflate: Apply the Inflate text transform to 'Target' in the SmartArt.
TextEffectTransformGallery.wave_1: Apply the Wave 1 text transform to 'Target' in the SmartArt.

TextEffects3DRotationGallery.isometric_left_down: Apply the Isometric Left Down 3D rotation to 'Target' in the SmartArt.
TextEffects3DRotationGallery.perspective_contrasting_left: Apply the Perspective Contrasting Left 3D rotation to 'Target' in the SmartArt.

TextFillColorPicker.blue: Fill the 'Target' text in the SmartArt with Blue (RGB: 0, 0, 255).
TextFillColorPicker.green: Fill the 'Target' text in the SmartArt with Green (RGB: 0, 176, 80).
TextFillColorPicker.red: Fill the 'Target' text in the SmartArt with Red (RGB: 255, 0, 0).

_3DBevelPictureTopGallery.angle: Apply the Angle top bevel effect to the picture.
_3DBevelPictureTopGallery.convex: Apply the Convex top bevel effect to the picture.
_3DBevelPictureTopGallery.soft_round: Apply the Soft Round top bevel effect to the picture.

_3DRotationGallery.isometric_left_down: Add an Isometric Left Down 3D rotation effect to the shape.
_3DRotationGallery.isometric_right_up: Add an Isometric Right Up 3D rotation effect to the shape.
_3DRotationGallery.perspective_above: Add a Perspective Above 3D rotation effect to the shape.
